stories.quote: Since moving to Hightide, I spend only about 10% of the time I used to on emails and booking administration. Before, every enquiry meant creating a personalised quote by email and manually entering bookings into Excel spreadsheets, a shared calendar and OneNote. Only around 30–40% of those enquiries actually became bookings, so a huge amount of time was spent on emails that never led anywhere. We worked like that for years because we couldn't find a booking system that was both affordable and flexible enough for our business. Our surf camp packages aren't priced by nightly rates, so most systems simply couldn't handle the way we sell and price our packages. With Hightide, guests can now see the different package lengths, room types and options online and book exactly what they need without waiting for a personalised quote. At reception, our staff have a much clearer overview of bookings, payments, check-ins, check-outs and guest add-ons, making day-to-day operations much smoother and easier to manage. Hightide has allowed us to keep the way our business works while removing almost all of the manual administration that used to come with it. It's saved us an incredible amount of time, made life much easier for our team, and finally gave us a booking system that fits the way our business actually operates.
stories.name: Dani

stories.quote: Running a dive centre and a hostel means managing accommodation, dives, courses, and complete dive camp packages as part of the same guest experience. Previously, we used accommodation booking software alongside Google Calendar, so bookings had to be managed across several different places. We wanted customers to be able to book our complete dive camp packages online, while giving our team one place to manage everything included in their stay. Hightide gave us the opportunity to bring all of that together. Our customers and online travel agents can now see and book our dive camp packages alongside our accommodation-only options. At the same time, we can continue selling accommodation through channels such as Booking.com and Hostelworld, which helps us fill available rooms during quieter periods. Our operation is complex, and we have certainly pushed Hightide to its limits. Whenever we have encountered a challenge, the team has worked with us to find a solution. I never thought it would be possible for guests to book a complete dive camp online with little to no interaction from our staff, but we are now seeing that happen. We have gained all of this functionality while paying approximately the same as we did for our previous system, which only managed accommodation. If your business also has several sides to it, I would recommend booking a call with Hightide and seeing what it could do for you.
stories.name: Cristovão

stories.quote: We moved to Hightide because we wanted a booking system that was easier to manage and better suited to the way our business operates. The transition was smooth, our team learned the system quickly, and we've never looked back. Before Hightide, we used Bookinglayer. It's a very capable system, but we wanted something that required less configuration and worked the way we needed it to from the start. Hightide gave us that without compromising on the functionality our business relies on. The Online Store provides a modern, polished booking experience for our customers, while managing bookings is straightforward for our team. The migration was supported throughout, making the switch much easier than we expected.
stories.name: Pedro

stories.quote: Hightide has made it much easier to organise reservations, track payments and share availability. We are now receiving many bookings directly through our Online Store, which saves time and gives customers more confidence. Before Hightide, I managed bookings through WhatsApp and Instagram and tracked everything in an Excel calendar, which meant a lot of back and forth over pricing, payments and availability.
stories.name: Pete Webb

stories.quote: Direct bookings have been a game changer for us. Hightide makes bookings much easier to manage and brings everything together at a reasonable price, without hidden fees. Before Hightide, I managed everything through Google Calendar, which made the booking flow, blocking unavailable dates and offering direct bookings difficult. I am very happy with it.
stories.name: Alessandro Rista
